item.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music industry update. If you're in the music business, you know how important it is to stay on top of the latest events and happenings. That's why Billboard Pro has just launched a brand new music industry events calendar, and we're excited to share it with you."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This calendar is your one-stop-shop for all the major national and international music industry events, from conferences to festivals, and even networking mixers. Whether you're an artist, producer, or industry professional, this calendar has got you covered."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Some highlights to look out for include the Grammy Awards on February 7th, 2027, in Los Angeles, and the Electric Daisy Carnival, or EDC, in Las Vegas from May 13th to 24th, 2027. And with the calendar covering all the way up to March 2028, you can plan ahead and make sure you don't miss out on any of the action."
[Short music transition]
Host: "So, how can you get your event listed on the calendar? It's simple - just reach out to joe.maimone@billboard.com for more information. Don't miss out on this opportunity to stay connected with the music industry and make your mark."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update."
